scopeOfAccept: Not applicable — this review is a REJECT. For the avoidance of doubt about what the REJECT does and does not say: the D-293 Decision 8 delegation edge, the DECISIONS-RECOMMENDED.md pin, every digest, both fixture witnesses and every one of the fourteen dispatch attacks are sound. The REJECT rests solely on SF-1, an incomplete speaker rename that leaves the successor's own standing unstated at ten load-bearing fields.
rationale: golden.v2 exists to land one thing, and it lands it. The Codex golden.v1 SHOULD-FIX asked for an explicit D-293 Decision 8 basedOn edge and a DECISIONS-RECOMMENDED.md pin; both are present, mutually consistent, digest-correct, and faithful to the live text of Decision 8 including its exact constraint list and its 'two DR-122 SARIF fixture obligations' phrase. The subject also correctly separates D-056 lawfulness from D-293 delegation, which was the conceptual point of the SHOULD-FIX. Every substantive attack in the dispatch is refuted against live bytes: 44 digest assertions recomputed with zero mismatches, both fixtures schema-valid against the live closed vocabulary and union, the runId omission lawful because runId is optional on the interrupted variant, the platform list quoted and ORDERED-EQUAL in both directions, and no minting, collapsing, closing, remasuring or advertising anywhere. What the successor did not do is finish being a successor. The rename from golden.v1 to golden.v2 was applied to eight fields and skipped at ten others, all of which sit in the roles, pass properties and open-question standings that state what this artifact does with respect to each cited input. Nothing there is false — every one of those sentences is true of the frozen predecessor, and true of the successor too, since the fixture semantics were preserved byte-for-byte — and every misattributed disclaimer is separately asserted at speaker level elsewhere in the file, so no attack succeeds through the gap. But a design-contract candidate whose whole function is precise custody should not name a different frozen artifact as the subject of its own standing, and should not disagree with itself about who is speaking in eight places versus ten.
